MEET THE FOUNDER

One sneakerhead's dream, built for every sneakerhead in India 🇮🇳

Ankit — Founder & CEO

Hey, I'm Ankit. Like most of you, I grew up scrolling past sneakers I loved but could never really afford. That gap between "I want this" and "I can actually buy this" stuck with me — so one day, I decided to close it myself.

ANKICKS started as a simple idea: what if the sneakers everyone hypes up — Nike, Adidas, Balenciaga, Jordan, Yeezy — were finally within reach for the everyday Indian sneakerhead? No middlemen markups, no inflated showroom prices. Just the kicks you want, at a price that actually makes sense.

Every single order that leaves this place is packed by me, personally — because behind every box is someone trusting a young founder with their hard-earned money, and that's not something I take lightly. Here's to building this together, one pair at a time. 🙏
